title: What a Circle Membership Year Is Granted in Benefit Credit
content:
## The benefit credit standing on a Circle membership

The unspent benefit credit on a Northbeam Circle Membership is granted membership benefit credit still
available to spend against delivery, installation, haul-away and repair charges.

## What a membership year is granted

A membership activated part way through a year is granted the full credits of its tier for that year;
credits are never prorated on the way in. An upgrade grants the difference between the new tier's credits
and the credits already granted in that membership year; a downgrade grants nothing further until the next
anniversary. Nothing is granted for a membership year in which the membership was in lapsed or cancelled
standing on the anniversary day.

## How long a granted credit lasts

A granted credit stays spendable for the expiry days of the tier and is then written off; an unspent
credit is never carried into the next membership year and is never paid out.

## A clause of this policy no longer in force

The clause granting the named benefit credits of the tier once per membership year on the activation
anniversary, with the grant year recorded so that a second grant in the same year could not be booked, is
**no longer in force**. The four named credit figures and the credit life recorded for each tier remain
figures of the tier.

## Cases on the grant of a membership year

A membership upgraded part way through a membership year, having already been granted the credits of its
former tier for that year, is granted the difference between the new tier's credits and what has already
been granted in that year, and not the new tier's credits over again. A membership downgraded part way
through the year is granted nothing further until the next anniversary, and the credits already granted
for that year are left as they stand. A membership standing lapsed on the anniversary day of a year is
granted nothing for that year, whatever it is reinstated to afterwards.

superseded_clauses: The named benefit credits of the tier are granted once per membership year, on the activation anniversary, and the grant year is recorded so a second grant in the same year cannot be booked.
